question: What is claimed to be heard in the ear when it has come down through a succession of tradition?
premises: Something abiding in the ear is heard.
This is addressed to the goddess.
That which is heard is said to have come through succession of tradition.
inference: A teaching that has come by tradition is heard as abiding in the ear.
uncertainties: The identity of what is heard is not named in this verse.
plain_english: O goddess, that which has come down through tradition is heard abiding in the ear.
